Home.p-SpecialPointMarket: Tadle is designed to unlock illiquid assets in the crypto pre-market, leveling the playing field for all participants. With the Tadle Mission Marketplace, you can complete quests to earn Tadle Gems that can be traded immediately for USDT, and with the Tadle Points Marketplace, you trade project points from premier projects, and secure your position for upcoming airdrops and profits before a project's TGE.
Home.p-TradingPoints1: Skip the grind of airdrop farming and trade points easily. Points from select projects can be bought, sold, and traded as many times as desired. After purchasing, traders can relist points to earn potential profits with each sale.
Home.p-TradingPoints2: Sellers receive their funds instantly upon trade completion, and if orders go unfulfilled, sellers can cancel at any time and retrieve their collateral, if applicable. Early point creators earn a bonus: a percentage of all future transactions involving the points they introduced to the market.
Home.p-CompletingMissions: Engage with top crypto projects by completing quests to earn Tadle Gems, which can be traded instantly to receive rewards! By successfully completing project missions, you will receive Tadle Gems that you can trade for USDT or used for exclusive opportunities within the ecosystem. Tadle's Mission Marketplace provides a structured and transparent way to earn rewards through meaningful participation.
Home.p-OptimalCapitalEfficiency: No collateral is required for subsequent traders, and revenue can be earned upon the completion of the trade.
Home.p-SuperiorLiquidity: Points can be quickly bought or sold in the market without causing significant price changes, providing traders with the flexibility to enter and exit positions with ease.
Home.p-LowTradingFee: A fee of just 0.5%, which is substantially lower than fees in other markets.
Home.p-AdvancedTradingSystem: Tadle offers tools and metrics to help traders better understand the market and make more informed trading decisions.
Home.p-RobustSecurity: Tadle implements advanced security measures to safeguard user assets.
Home.p-DecentralizedArbitrationForSettlements: Tadle employs decentralized arbitration to ensure fair and transparent resolution for every case.

Home.p-WhatExactlyArePoints: Before issuing tokens, Web3 projects often run initiatives to boost user engagement, awarding points for participation. These points can potentially be exchanged for corresponding tokens in the future.
Home.cap-WhatIsTheTadlePointsMarketplace: What is the Tadle Points Marketplace?
Home.p-WhatIsTheTadlePointsMarketplace: The Points Marketplace allows users to buy and sell points with one another, providing a solution for those seeking liquidity before a project's token issuance.
Home.p-WhatIsTheMissionMarketplace: The Mission Marketplace allows users to complete quests from different projects, engaging in meaningful interactions with their ecosystem that will be rewarded with Tadle Gems upon completion that you can trade for USDT.
Home.p-WhatExactlyAreTadleGems: Unlike points that are issued by a project, to be either traded on Tadle or held on to for an airdrop, Tadle Gems are issued by Tadle to reward users for completing quests on the Mission Marketplace and they can be traded instantly for USDT.
